article.story: No. 19 Arizona (7-3) at Kansas State (4-6), Nov. 21 at 7 p.m. EST. Opening Line: Arizona by 7.5. Against the spread: Arizona 4-6, Kansas State 4-5-1. How to watch: Fox Sports 1 Key stats Arizona Offense Overall: 450.1 yards per game (19th in FBS) Passing: 326.2 yards per game (5th) Rushing: 123.9 yards per game (114th) Scoring: 34.7 points per game (22nd) Arizona Defense Overall: 345.7 yards per game (57th in FBS) Passing: 203.4 yards per game (53rd) Rushing: 142.3 yards per game (70th) Scoring: 21.9 points per game (44th) Kansas State Offense Overall: 404.2 yards per game (45th in FBS) Passing: 221.3 yards per game (74th) Rushing: 182.9 yards per game (40th) Scoring: 29.2 points per game (58th) Kansas State Defense Overall: 343.3 yards per game (50th in FBS) Passing: 178.2 yards per game (19th) Rushing: 165.1 yards per game (97th) Scoring: 26.1 points per game (87th) Arizona is 90th in defensive third down percentage, allowing opponents to convert 40.3% of the time. Kansas State ranks 8th on offense, converting on 50.7% of third downs. Kansas State ranks 102nd in the FBS with a -4 turnover margin, compared to Arizona's 51st-ranked +2 margin. Arizona ranks 95th in the FBS averaging 60.7 penalty yards per game, compared to Kansas State's 12th-ranked 39.2 per-game average. Arizona is 10th in FBS in red zone defense, allowing opponents to score on 73.3% of red zone trips. Both teams rank high in time of possession. Arizona is 16th in the FBS with an average time of possession of 32:22, while Kansas State's 21st-ranked average is 32:04. Team leaders Arizona Passing: Noah Fifita, 3,150 yards, 24 TDs, 6 INTs, 71.7 completion percentage Rushing: Kedrick Reescano, 414 yards on 108 carries, 8 TDs Receiving: Isaiah Mizell, 868 yards on 47 catches, 9 TDs Kansas State Passing: Avery Johnson, 1,301 yards, 10 TDs, 3 INTs, 63.1 completion percentage Rushing: Rodney Fields Jr., 607 yards on 122 carries, 6 TDs Receiving: Jaron Tibbs, 536 yards on 53 catches, 5 TDs Last game Arizona fell 40-39 to Utah on Nov. 14. Fifita led Arizona with 356 yards on 27-of-43 passing (62.8%) for three touchdowns and one interception. Reescano had 41 rushing yards on nine carries and one touchdown, adding one reception for zero yards. Chris Hunter had six receptions for 119 yards. Kansas State lost 20-10 to TCU on Nov. 14. Dillon Duff passed for 244 yards on 22-of-33 attempts (66.7%) with one touchdown and no interceptions. Fields had 33 rushing yards on nine carries, adding one reception for five yards. Tibbs put up 115 yards on eight catches with one touchdown. Next game Arizona hosts Arizona State on Nov. 28. Kansas State plays at Iowa State on Nov. 28.
